name: Trend Rider (EMA trend + ADX + market regime)
description: Rides established uptrends. Buys a pullback-and-recover through the 20-EMA when price is above the 50-EMA, the 50-EMA is above the 200-SMA, trend strength (ADX) is meaningful and the overall NEPSE market is not in a bear phase. Exits when the trend breaks or the ATR trailing stop is hit.

rules.entry: liquid == 1 and regime >= 0 and close > ema_50 and ema_50 > sma_200 and adx_14 > 20 and plus_di > minus_di and cross_above(close, ema_20)

name: Momentum Rotation (3-6 month relative strength)
description: NEPSE moves in strong, persistent waves driven by retail flows, so recent winners tend to keep winning for a few months. Each month hold the 8 liquid stocks with the best blended 3- and 6-month return that are above a rising 200-day average. Moves fully to cash when the market regime turns bearish.

rules.filter: liquid == 1 and close > sma_200 and sma200_slope > 0

warnings: Uses today's fundamentals for past dates (optimistic) until fundamental history builds up.

name: Volume Breakout (55-day high + volume surge)
description: Turtle / Darvas style breakout. Buys when price closes above its 55-day high on at least twice the normal volume, a pattern that often marks the start of big NEPSE moves. Exits on a close below the 20-day low.

rules.entry: liquid == 1 and regime >= 0 and close > hh_55 and vol_ratio > 2.0 and close > sma_200 and chg_pct > 0.02

name: Pullback in Uptrend (RSI-2 mean reversion)
description: Buys short, sharp dips (2-day RSI below 10) in stocks that are in a long-term uptrend, and sells into the bounce. Short holding periods.

rules.entry: liquid == 1 and regime >= 0 and close > sma_200 and ema_50 > sma_200 and rsi_2 < 10

name: Supertrend + MACD Confirmation
description: Buys when MACD crosses above its signal line while the Supertrend is bullish and price is above the 200-day average; exits when Supertrend flips.

rules.entry: liquid == 1 and st_dir > 0 and cross_above(macd, macd_signal) and close > sma_200

name: Quality at a Reasonable Price (fundamental)
description: Each quarter hold the 10 liquid, profitable stocks with the best combined value (low P/E and P/B versus sector peers, dividend yield) and quality (ROE) scores - but only while they are above their 200-day average, which avoids value traps in falling stocks.

rules.filter: liquid == 1 and eps > 0 and roe > 0.08 and pe > 0 and close > sma_200

warnings: Uses today's fundamentals for past dates (optimistic) until fundamental history builds up.

name: Sector Rotation (leaders in leading sectors)
description: Money rotates between NEPSE sectors (banks, hydro, microfinance, insurance...). Each month buy the strongest stocks inside the top-ranked sectors by relative strength.

rules.filter: liquid == 1 and sector_rs_rank >= 70 and close > ema_50

name: Composite Model (the screener's own BUY calls)
description: Follows the screener's composite score: each week hold the 10 highest-scoring stocks rated BUY or STRONG BUY, keep them while they stay rated HOLD or better, and step aside in a bear market. This is how the screener's own recommendations would have performed.
warnings: Uses today's fundamentals for past dates (optimistic) until fundamental history builds up.
